segments.he:
א.

עַל־יְדֵי זְרִיזוּת זוֹכֶה לִהְיוֹת רוֹעֶה נֶאֱמָן, וְסִימָן לַדָּבָר: לֵךְ אֶל נְ'מָ'לָ'ה' עָצֵל, וּכְתִיב: מִשָׁ'ם רוֹעֶ'ה אֶבֶ'ן יִשְׂרָאֵ'ל.

segments.en: One who keeps his learning hidden does not forget.
The elders uphold Israel, and their advice is good for us.
According to the elderly of the generation, so is the income.
If the elders are not wise, a sign of the matter is that their main esteem is by young women.

Through zeal, one merits to be a faithful shepherd  (leader of people) . An indication of this matter: "Go to the ant  ( nemalla ) , lazy one  (see its ways and wisen up - Mishlei – Proverbs 6:6) ." and the verse: "From there, the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel  (Bereshit 49:24) "  (the last letters of this second verse spell out  nemalla – ant, thus showing that the function of Shepherd is built on this quality of zeal).
